row: Equine Behavior Specialist (Equine PSY Certification) + Certified Equine Massage Therapist teaching horse people around the world how to connect equine behavior to what's happening in the horse physically, emotionally, and mentally. If you love learning, you'll love it here! We're new (ish) to YouTube - so make sure you subscribe to follow along!
